title: Sakura Japan Experience.
description: A peaceful Japanese world with cherry blossom shaders, traditional structures, custom textures, tatami mat rooms, and sushi cooking.
body:
![Japanese home](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d05720cf011525fc8216c8384759b6aaaec82c90.png)# 🌸 Sakura Japan Experience

Transform Minecraft into a stunning, peaceful Japanese world! This modpack compiles a custom cherry blossom shader, detailed traditional textures, immersive procedural world generation, and traditional cooking/building systems.

---

## ✨ Features Included

### 🏮 Authentic Shaders & Atmospheric Lighting
*   **Pastel Pink Color Grading:** Soft, warm, cozy ambient colors.
*   **Volumetric Bloom & Vignette:** Brings a dreamy, anime-style atmosphere to your game.
*   **Dynamic Falling Petals:** Sakura blossom petals float through the air, reacting to the wind.
*   **Sky Enhancements:** Gorgeous hand-drawn circular Anime Sun, detailed crescent Anime Moon, and soft pink clouds.

### 🧱 Japanese Resource Pack (Custom Textures)
*   **Architecture blocks:** Re-textured Dark Oak to *Charred Cedar (Yakisugi)*, Spruce to *Temple Beams*, Bamboo to *Tatami Flooring*, and White Concrete to *Shirokabe Plaster*.
*   **Shoji Screens:** Vanilla glass blocks changed to traditional paper sliding screens.
*   **Lanterns:** Vines replaced with strings of hanging red-and-gold paper lanterns to easily decorate your gardens.
*   **Moss Gardens:** Custom garden moss covered in fallen pink sakura petals.
*   **Villager Outfits:** Default villagers are dressed in beautiful red-and-white *Kimonos* with gold *Obi* sashes!

### 🏯 World Generation & Shrines (Mods)
*   **Procedural Towns & Villages:** Spawns massive traditional villages, Shinto shrines, and pagodas across the world (via *qrafty's Japanese Villages* and *Wabi-Sabi Structures*).
*   **Endless Cherry Forests:** *Terralith* makes the overworld generate massive, realistic cherry blossom forests and scenic valleys.
*   **TatamiCraft:** Adds placeable tatami mats, screens, and room dividers in creative and survival.

### 🍣 Traditional Farming & Foods
*   **Farmer's & Cultural Delights:** Grow rice crops, avocados, and cucumbers to roll your own **Sushi**, cook **Ramen**, and serve **Green Tea**!

### 🎵 Traditional Music
*   Replaces title screen ambient tracks with peaceful, authentic **traditional Japanese Koto instrument music**.

---

## 🛠️ How to Install

1. Download and install the **Modrinth App** (or your preferred launcher like Prism).
2. Click **Add Instance** / **Import** and select the `.mrpack` file.
3. Launch the game!
4. **Important Settings:**
    *   Enable the **SakuraJapan** resource pack in Options -> Resource Packs.
    *   Enable the **CherryBlossomShader** in Video Settings -> Shaders.
5. Create a new world using seed `8460256549298285514` to spawn directly next to a cherry grove structure!
